subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI add a channel-based separated/merged session view, and should that live as a narrow Sessions-page mode or inside broader sessions-workspace work?
rationale: The request is useful but changes UX, session-state visibility, privacy expectations, and possibly Gateway protocol/query semantics; source inspection shows no current contract that automation can safely infer.

options.title: Define Channel View Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue canonical for the channel-specific feature, choose separated tabs plus merged timeline rules, and then implement the smallest protocol/UI surface needed.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 the canonical product direction if maintainers want channel views, peek, inline reply, and status semantics designed together.

options.title: Defer The Toggle
options.body: Leave the current Sessions table and per-session chat navigation as the supported behavior until stronger user evidence justifies a new channel timeline surface.

recommendation.title: Define Channel View Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical for the channel-specific feature, choose separated tabs plus merged timeline rules, and then implement the smallest protocol/UI surface needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-management and gateway protocol history makes this the best available routing owner for the product/API boundary decision.
